findings.detail: C8-local resolver preserves Gregorian local year/month/day/hour/minute/second plus original milliseconds, clamps month-end, avoids Date.UTC years0..99 remapping, and leaves elapsed-day arithmetic unchanged. No shared internal-calendar converter change and no earlier/later/gap-shift preference.

Enumerates all 172801 integral-second offsets inclusively within +/-24h, comparing complete locale-fixed Gregorian/latn/era/h23 whole-second strings. Zero or multiple matches refuse with C8CalendarInstantUnavailable. Source offset bound and AD1..9999 calendar domain are checked. This is not an all-offset/all-calendar/all-history guarantee.

At most256 entries keyed by zone and exact whole-second civil target; value is an instant or unavailable, not source/policy/current actor authority. Returned Date is fresh and each caller milliseconds are added outside cache.
